title: Marcia's Texture Pack!
description: This is a model pack made by myself (Anavolus/Marcia) showcasing my models and textures that I have made myself for my own character as well as many other characters on Tall Tales RP. May begin commission eventually.
body:
# **_Small Story_**
Hi there! My name is Marcia, this is a texture pack featuring many textures and models made by myself and others for use on characters as cosmetics for TTRP!

The pack is being put here now as a way of distributing it a little bit more and having some of my first and most loved attempts at making custom models/textures for characters being more widely seen across server. This is mainly being done as a way of displaying my models in game instead of things like figura!

## **_What is in the pack_**
The pack contains many different cosmetics made by myself as well as small additions from friends. These models are custom made for the players that I have made them for and only them, please do not use them if you are not the person made for them. I may open commissions and such to have 3D and 2D textures made in the future but for now these are all that are featured in the pack.
